entries.d416bbcc5686ae32: A single segment of M&A brokerage for mid-sized and small and medium-sized enterprises. It supports the entire M&A process, from matching companies wishing to sell with companies wishing to buy, through coordinating partnership terms and preparing contract documents, to executing transactions. It includes operations in which it receives fees from both parties while standing in a neutral position, and operations in which it supports one side as the buyer or transferee and receives fees only from that side, and it may also perform only some tasks, such as corporate valuation, support for preparing contract documents, or consulting. Revenue for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥1,487 million, and the number of M&A deals completed was 105. Deal origination relies mainly on referrals from financial institutions and accounting firms with which it has business alliances. In addition to its head office in Nagoya, it has offices in Osaka, Shizuoka, Takamatsu and Tokyo.
